title: 104쪽 · 3x CO Open — BB 3-Bet + CO 4-Bet (Pot)
sourcePageBasis: capture sequence, checked against surrounding folios
paragraphs: Some of my poker confidants got a little confused by this chart but | am not sure what the big deal is. The cutoff's Opening range is tighter than the button’s, so the big blind has less incentive to aebat than the small blind, and Snowie elected to call instead of 4-betting with A-Ko,

The only noteworthy thing alan this on a the fact that Snowie is now 4-betting light with A-2 - A-8s because It isn't opening all the offsuit aces from the cutoff. | love watching the simple adaptations here and there — billions and billions of iterations. it’s like watching evolution in real time and observing the survival of the fittest.
